nodes.description: Address of current contract owner, set in Owned constructor and updated in acceptOwnership.

Cached total supply, minted to the deployer address in the constructor.
Mapping of account address to token balance; updated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount; written by approve and approveAndCall and consumed by transferFrom.
Checked addition helper returning a + b with a require(c >= a) overflow guard.
Checked subtraction helper returning a - b guarded by require(b <= a).
Checked multiplication helper returning a * b guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Checked division helper returning a / b guarded by require(b > 0).
Owned constructor that assigns msg.sender as the initial owner.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Two-step ownership transfer acceptance; requires msg.sender == newOwner then swaps owner/newOwner.
Token constructor that sets metadata, mints the entire supply to a fixed address and emits Transfer.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)]; performs an unchecked subtraction.
Returns the token balance of tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Spends allowance and moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' using SafeMath helpers.
Returns remaining allowance of spender over tokenOwner's tokens.
Sets allowance then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval; state is written before the untrusted external call.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner rescue function performing an external ERC20 transfer of arbitrary tokens held by the contract.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the caller msg.sender to the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership body executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner, making the caller the access-control gate.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so caller address determines the affected account.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] keyed by the caller address.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender], so caller address selects the allowance slot.
approveAndCall keys the allowance by msg.sender and forwards it to receiveApproval.
Owned constructor writes owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership stores the supplied address into newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner to owner after the caller check.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0) after the ownership swap.
Constructor initialises the token symbol.
Constructor initialises the token name.
Constructor initialises token decimals.
Constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed minted amount.
Constructor mints the entire supply into the deployer balance slot.
totalSupply reads the cached _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] to subtract burned tokens.
The subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] is computed without SafeMath protection.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the queried account.
transfer writes updated balances for the sender and recipient.
transfer delegates balance accounting to safeSub.
transfer delegates recipient crediting to safeAdd.
approve writes the requested value into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom updates the from/to balance entries.
transferFrom decrements the spender's allowance entry.
transferFrom uses safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom uses safeAdd to credit the recipient.
allowance reads the allowed nested mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowance before any external interaction.
approveAndCall invokes untrusted spender code through receiveApproval after updating allowance.
The reentrant callee can re-enter allowance-mutating functions because allowed was written before the external call.
Untrusted callee can recursively re-enter approveAndCall while the outer call has not yet returned.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an owner-supplied token contract.
Return value of the external ERC20 transfer is returned by transferAnyERC20Token; owner-gated so no privilege escalation.
safeAdd performs the raw addition that could overflow if the require guard were absent or bypassed.
safeSub performs the raw subtraction that could underflow if the require guard were absent.
safeMul performs the raw multiplication that could overflow if the require guard were absent.
safeAdd consumes its first operand parameter.
safeAdd consumes its second operand parameter.
safeSub consumes its first operand parameter.
safeSub consumes its second operand parameter.
safeMul consumes its first operand parameter.
safeMul consumes its second operand parameter.
safeDiv consumes its numerator parameter.
safeDiv consumes its denominator parameter.
transferOwnership consumes the _newOwner parameter.
balanceOf consumes the tokenOwner parameter.
allowance consumes the tokenOwner parameter.
allowance consumes the spender parameter.
transfer consumes the recipient address parameter.
transfer consumes the token amount parameter.
approve consumes the spender parameter.
approve consumes the tokens parameter.
transferFrom consumes the from address parameter.
transferFrom consumes the to address parameter.
transferFrom consumes the tokens amount parameter.
approveAndCall consumes the spender parameter and uses it as the callback target.
approveAndCall consumes the tokens parameter for the allowance and callback.
approveAndCall forwards the arbitrary data parameter into the external call.
transferAnyERC20Token consumes the tokenAddress parameter for the external call target.
transferAnyERC20Token consumes the tokens amount parameter.
safeAdd stores the computed sum in local c.
safeSub stores the computed difference in local c.
safeMul stores the computed product in local c.
safeDiv stores the computed quotient in local c.
transfer returns the local success flag.
approve returns the local success flag.
transferFrom returns the local success flag.
approveAndCall returns the local success flag.
transferAnyERC20Token returns the local success flag taken from the external call.
balanceOf writes the named return local balance.
allowance writes the named return local remaining.
